column1: # **The shop greeting is a lottery.** The route passes Iolo's Bows, and
# `shops.md` Section 8.A draws the entry greeting from a `SHOPPE.DAT` pool that
# `prng.md` Section 3 makes non-comparable - measured 2026-09-12 the stock drew
# `"Hail, friend! Wouldst thou Buy or Sell "` and this engine
# `"Greetings, traveller! ..."`. Beats carrying that greeting have measured
# nothing about the attack this scenario is for.
# **The merchant's cell on arrival is a lottery too.** Traced 2026-10-16
# from the run timelapses: both sides walk the resident in lockstep while
# the party is within three of its 10:00 waypoint (AI 4, `npc-schedules.md`
# §9), but for the three steps the party spends four or five cells away -
# the last West and the first North - it falls back to the §9.1 wander, one
# coin and one direction per turn off a generator `prng.md` §3 seeds from
# the host clock. Ten stock runs of this unchanged scenario put it on six
# different cells and ended in the shop greeting six times, `Nothing to
# attack!` three times and the arena once. Re-counted 2026-10-16 over the
# sixteen stock runs since 2026-09-12: shop greeting eleven times, `Nothing
# to attack!` four, the arena once - and the engine drew all three outcomes
# too (rc1 at 22:08 opened the arena after `Thou dost see cobble`, as stock
# did on 2026-09-18 13:29). The deterministic half is pinned by the `p15_`
# Town combat entry, reached by walking in rather than from a seeded save.
# `combat-town-attack` seeds the party at the counter from an engine-written
# save at 12:00, when the weaponsmith is seated: the stock game answers that
# Attack with nothing at all - no message, no arena - while the engine opens a
# MERCHANT conflict. That is the same seated/at-the-shop split u5-spec#214 is
# about, on the Attack command instead of Talk, and an engine-written seed
# cannot tell the two apart. This walks into Britain at 10:00, when the
# resident is at the shop, and attacks the same cell the shop scenario talks
# Seeded rather than walked to. The walk-up form of this scenario scripted its
# way in from the town gate, and the resident walks its own schedule while
# those steps run, so the two sides arrived with it in different cells and
# every later beat compared unrelated windows (`cleak/u5-engine#22`).
# `qa/tools/reseed.py` replayed that walk once into the seed named below.
